title: Concept: Shell execution from VBA or VB in vbnet — review required
description: In vbnet, the runtime shell helper is invoked. The macro or application runs with the signed-in user, so a document that reaches this call can start any program the user can start. This is the execution primitive behind a large share of malicious Office documents, which is why it warrants review even in internal tooling.
applicability: vbnet Office macros and desktop applications.
risk: Arbitrary program execution with the user identity; HIGH severity.
